name: Ashley Mizuki Robbins
original_name: アシュレイ・ミズキ・ロビンズ
source: A 16-year-old meek and sensitive girl who aspires to become a musician. She has been living with her father for the past two years, though she is emotionally distant from him due to their long-time separation. She travels to Lake Juliet after being invited by her father. She has dim memories of being there with her mother.
